name: pfaststore
description: Precise integer system-fast-store regression. A present/read-only PTE covers ordinary 32-bit MOV [disp32],r32 at linear 0x401000. The #PF handler records P|W=3, makes the PTE writable, flushes CR3 and IRETs. Correct behaviour leaves the first store uncommitted until its restart, preserves the sentinel readback, and then executes 128 ordinary MOV stores. A final MOV at 0x400fff crosses a 4 KiB boundary and is intentionally required to use the established slow fragment path. The dedicated gate differentially compares QEMU and requires that split plus the non-crossing S_PIPE store loop; no game-specific state or save-state is used.
